userStories.title: Refactor install.sh to use templates and lib.sh
userStories.description: As a developer, I want install.sh to be a clean orchestrator that sources lib.sh, copies templates, and substitutes placeholders.
acceptanceCriteria: install.sh sources scripts/lib.sh for logging, check_not_root(), check_arch(), check_command()
New --variant gold|minimal flag added (default: gold)
Existing --icons / --no-icons flags still work
Template processing: reads templates/config-<variant>.jsonc, replaces {{PLACEHOLDER}} with actual values via sed
Gold variant: copies templates/scripts/*.sh to $CONFIG_DIR/scripts/ and chmod +x
Minimal variant: skips helper script installation entirely
All inline heredocs for config and helper scripts removed
Unknown --variant value prints error and exits 1
Backup logic unchanged (same rotation, same paths, same 5-backup limit)
Idempotent: re-running creates backup then overwrites
All paths properly quoted, no word-splitting vulnerabilities
shellcheck passes on install.sh
userStories.notes: This is the largest story but it's a direct refactor — logic stays the same, just reorganized. The heredoc removal + template copy is mechanical.

userStories.title: Create GitHub Actions CI workflow
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want CI that runs shellcheck and bats on every push/PR.
acceptanceCriteria: .github/workflows/ci.yml exists (replaces old test.yml)
Old .github/workflows/test.yml is deleted
Job 'lint': runs shellcheck on install.sh, uninstall.sh, scripts/lib.sh, templates/scripts/*.sh
Job 'test': installs bats-core, runs bats tests/

Job 'smoke-arch': archlinux:latest container, runs install.sh --no-icons --variant gold, verifies config.jsonc and scripts exist; then runs install.sh --no-icons --variant minimal, verifies config.jsonc exists
Triggers on push and pull_request
All jobs use ubuntu-latest (smoke uses archlinux container)
Workflow completes in under 5 minutes
